description: Every correction applied to the alloy data after extraction from the annotated source spreadsheet. Together with the upstream file this ledger reproduces the committed training set exactly; see evaluation/prediction/scripts/verify_training_provenance.py.

entries.rationale: Nickel balance. With Ni = 33.0 the composition sums to 67.2 wt%; 66.0 restores it to 100.2. A transposed leading digit.
Nickel balance. With Ni = 33.0 the composition sums to 67.3 wt%; 66.0 restores it to 100.3. Same defect as CMSX-2.
Negative tensile strength at the same temperature as the yield-strength defect above, in the same source row.
Negative yield strength. |240| continues the alloy's decline with temperature and sits below the tensile strength at the same point.
Molybdenum overstated. With Mo = 10.0 the composition sums to 108.1 wt%; 1.5 restores it to 99.6.
Negative elastic modulus. |159| continues the modulus decline 172/159/150/136 across the temperature series.
Molybdenum omitted entirely. Without it the composition sums to 89.75 wt%; M-252 is a nominally 10 wt% Mo alloy and adding it restores 99.75.
Elastic modulus of 15.6 GPa is an order of magnitude below any metal; 156.0 GPa is consistent with the alloy's series and with nickel-base moduli at 871 C. A misplaced decimal point.
Tensile strength of 150 MPa at 538 C is below the alloy's own yield strength and far below its 825 MPa at room temperature; 650 MPa continues the series. A transposed leading digit.
Nickel balance. With Ni = 49.5 the composition sums to 109.8 wt%; 39.7 restores it to 100.0.
Iron understated. With Fe = 3.0 the composition sums to 73.0 wt%; 30.0 restores it to 100.0. A dropped trailing zero.

Negative yield strength. |205| continues the decline 730/690/675/585 and sits below the tensile strength of 415 at the same temperature. Identical defect class and identical source column to RGT* 13, whose value could not be resolved and was withdrawn as erratum 2.
Transposed decimal. Special Metals specifies Ti 1.0-1.8 wt% for PE16; 12.0 left the composition summing to 111.0 wt%, and 1.2 restores 100.2.

Negative yield strength recorded verbatim as '-435' in the annotated source. Two readings remain open -- a stray dash on 435 MPa, or a 'no data' dash run together with the empty 982 C column -- so the measurement is withdrawn rather than guessed. Same defect class as T14 (RGT* 4), which was resolved as a sign error; that precedent is not source confirmation and was not followed here.
